title: link org wide CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md
body:
With the new community repo we use that for the org wide documents such as CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md. CONTRIBUTING_GO.md is also stored there now.

So do not duplicate the content here and just link them.

We also do not have any rust projects in this org so that file should just be deleted, we can copy it into netavark.
